en.t: Battle of Glenmama: The combined forces of Munster and Meath under king Brian Boru inflict a crushing defeat on the allied armies of Leinster and Dublin near Lyons Hill in Ireland
en.s: The Battle of Glenn Máma or Glenmama (Irish: Cath Ghleann Máma, The Battle of "The Glen of the Gap") took place most probably near Lyons Hill in Ardclough, County Kildare, Ireland, in AD 999 between Windmill Hill and Blackchurch. It was the decisive and only engagement of the brief Leinster revolt of 999–1000 against the King of Munster, Brian Boru.

zh.s: 格伦马马战役（爱尔兰语：Cath Ghleann Máma，意为“峡谷之口之战”）可能发生在公元999年爱尔兰基尔代尔郡阿德克洛附近的莱昂斯山一带，地点位于风车山与布莱克丘奇之间。这是999至1000年伦斯特对芒斯特国王布赖恩·博鲁发动的短暂叛乱中唯一的一场决战，并决定了叛乱结果。

en.s: The siege of Tortosa (1 July – 30 December 1148) was a military action of the Second Crusade (1147–49) in Spain. A multinational force under the command of Count Raymond Berengar IV of Barcelona besieged the city of Tortosa (Arabic Ṭurṭūsha), then a part of the Almoravid Emirate, for six months before the garrison surrendered.

en.s: The naval Battle of La Rochelle of 1419 took place between a Castilian and an allied Flemish-Hanseatic fleet. The Castilian victory resulted in their naval supremacy in the Bay of Biscay. but it also led to a protracted conflict with Flanders and the Hanseatic League, which ended in 1443 with further commercial concessions to Castile. The battle was notable for the use of guns by the Castilian fleet.

zh.s: 1419年12月30日，卡斯蒂利亚舰队与佛兰德斯—汉萨同盟联合舰队在海上交战。卡斯蒂利亚获胜，确立了在比斯开湾的海上优势，但也因此与佛兰德斯和汉萨同盟陷入长期冲突，直至1443年才以对卡斯蒂利亚作出更多贸易让步告终。这场海战以卡斯蒂利亚舰队使用火炮而闻名。

en.s: The Battle of Wakefield took place in Sandal Magna near Wakefield, in West Yorkshire in Northern England, on 30 December 1460. It was a major battle of the Wars of the Roses. The opposing forces were an army led by nobles loyal to the captive King Henry VI of the House of Lancaster, his Queen Margaret of Anjou and their seven-year-old son Edward, Prince of Wales on one side, and the army of Richard, Duke of York, the rival claimant to the throne, on the other. For several years before the battle, the Duke of York had become increasingly opposed to the weak King Henry's court.

zh.s: 1460年12月30日，玫瑰战争期间，兰开斯特派与约克公爵理查德率领的约克派军队在英格兰北部韦克菲尔德附近的桑德尔马格纳交战。兰开斯特派拥护被俘的亨利六世及其王后安茹的玛格丽特和七岁的儿子威尔士亲王爱德华；理查德则是王位的竞争者。

The town had been captured the previous month in the first siege of 1745 by the Jacobite army that invaded England in November 1745 and reached as far south as Derby, before turning back on 6 December.

en.s: The Battle of Hammond’s Store was a conflict that occurred at Hammond’s Old Store near modern-day Clinton, Laurens County, South Carolina. The battle happened in response to Lieutenant Colonel Thomas Waters’ raids of Patriot settlements in South Carolina. On Christmas Day of 1780, Brigadier General Daniel Morgan called on Lieutenant Colonel William Washington to attack Lieutenant Colonel Thomas Waters’ men after getting word of his destructive movement through South Carolina.

zh.s: 哈蒙德旧店战役发生在南卡罗来纳州劳伦斯县、今克林顿附近的哈蒙德旧店。战斗起因是托马斯·沃特斯中校袭击南卡罗来纳州爱国者定居点。1780年圣诞节，丹尼尔·摩根准将获悉沃特斯中校在南卡罗来纳州的破坏行动后，命令威廉·华盛顿中校攻击其部队。

en.s: In the Battle of Mansilla or Battle of Mansilla de las Mulas on 30 December 1808 an Imperial French corps led by Nicolas Soult caught up with a Spanish corps commanded by Pedro Caro, 3rd Marquis of la Romana. Soult's cavalry under Jean Baptiste Marie Franceschi-Delonne overran la Romana's rear guard led by General Martinengo. Mansilla de las Mulas is a town located 17 kilometres (11 mi) southeast of León, Spain. The combat occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars. La Romana's Spanish corps cooperated with Sir John Moore's British army in its advance into northern Spain and in its subsequent retreat to the northwest.

zh.s: 1808年12月30日，尼古拉·苏尔特率领的法兰西帝国军在曼西利亚追上佩德罗·卡罗（拉罗马纳侯爵）指挥的西班牙军。让-巴蒂斯特·弗朗切斯基-德隆指挥的法军骑兵击溃了马丁内戈将军率领的西班牙后卫。曼西利亚位于西班牙莱昂东南约17公里处。这场战斗发生在半岛战争期间。

en.s: The Battle of Buffalo (also known as the Battle of Black Rock) took place during the War of 1812 on December 30, 1813, in the State of New York, near the Niagara River. The British forces drove off the American defenders and destroyed many buildings and ships. The operation was retaliation for American troops burning the Canadian village of Newark (present day Niagara-on-the-Lake).

zh.s: 1813年12月30日，1812年战争期间，英军在纽约州尼亚加拉河附近击退美军守军，并摧毁许多建筑和船只。这次行动是对美军此前焚毁加拿大纽瓦克村（今尼亚加拉湖畔镇）的报复。此战也称黑岩之战。

en.s: Hadži-Prodan's rebellion (Serbian: Хаџи-Проданова буна/Hadži-Prodanova buna) was a Serbian rebellion against the Ottoman Empire, which took place from 27 September to 30 December 1814. It occurred between the First (1804–13) and Second (1815) uprisings of the Serbian Revolution. Despite the collapse of the First Uprising in 1813, tensions in the Sanjak of Smederevo ("Belgrade Pashalik") nevertheless persisted. In September 1814 a rebellion was launched by veteran Hadži-Prodan in the Požega nahija.

zh.s: 塞尔维亚人反抗奥斯曼帝国的哈吉·普罗丹起义于1814年9月27日至12月30日进行，发生在塞尔维亚革命第一次和第二次起义之间。1813年第一次起义失败后，斯梅代雷沃桑贾克（“贝尔格莱德帕夏辖区”）的局势仍然紧张。1814年9月，老兵哈吉·普罗丹在波热加县发动起义。

en.s: The Battle of Mór took place during the Hungarian Revolution of 1848 on 30 December 1848 between Austria and Hungarian Revolutionary Army. The Austrians were led by Croatian Ban Lieutenant General Josip Jelačić, while the Hungarians were led by Major General Mór Perczel. The Austrians were victorious and, subsequently, the Hungarian main army led by Artúr Görgei lost the last chance to stop the Austrian armies which were threatening the Hungarian capitals Pest and Buda.

zh.s: 1848年12月30日，匈牙利革命期间，奥地利军队与匈牙利革命军在莫尔交战。奥军由克罗地亚总督约瑟普·耶拉契奇中将率领，匈军由莫尔·佩采尔少将指挥。奥军获胜，匈牙利主力部队随后失去阻止奥军威胁佩斯和布达的最后机会。

en.s: The 1866 Victorian colonial election was held from 30 December 1865 to 29 January 1866 to elect the 5th Parliament of Victoria. All 78 seats in 49 electorates in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though ten seats were uncontested. There were 24 single-member, 21 two-member and 4 three-member electorates.

en.s: The Angostura Fortress was a Paraguayan Army fortification, located by the Pikysyry stream (a tributary of the Paraguay river), in Paraguayan territory. The Paraguayan War,[A] (also known as the War of the Triple Alliance[B] and the Great War[4][C] in Paraguay), was a South American war fought from 1864 to 1870 between Paraguay and the Triple Alliance nations (Argentina, the Empire of Brazil, and Uruguay).

zh.s: 安戈斯图拉要塞是巴拉圭军队的一座防御工事，位于巴拉圭境内皮基西里溪畔；该溪流是巴拉圭河的支流。巴拉圭战争（又称三国同盟战争，在巴拉圭也称“大战争”）是1864年至1870年间南美洲的一场战争，交战方为巴拉圭与三国同盟（阿根廷、巴西帝国和乌拉圭）。

en.s: The Jementah Civil War broke out in 1879 in Jementah in northern Johor when Tengku Alam Shah, the heir of late Sultan Ali of the autonomous principality of Muar refused to surrender the principality to the central administration of Abu Bakar, the then Maharaja of Johor. The aftermath of the conflict led to the consolidation of Johor's rules over Muar territory again and the opening of Muar town by Sultan Abu Bakar as the first sultan of modern Johor.

The battle was caused by the Mahdist blockade of the Ginnis-Kosha Fort, which British commanders hoped to relieve.

zh.t: 菲律宾爱国者、改革倡导者何塞·黎刹被西班牙行刑队处决
zh.s: 何塞·普罗塔西奥·黎刹·梅尔卡多·阿隆索·雷阿隆达（西班牙语：[xoˈse riˈsal, -ˈθal]；他加禄语：[hoˈse ɾiˈsal]；1861年6月19日—1896年12月30日）是菲律宾民族主义者、作家和博学者，活跃于菲律宾西班牙殖民统治末期。他被普遍视为菲律宾民族英雄。

en.t: Scott’s Discovery team reaches its farthest south
en.s: On December 30, 1902, Robert Falcon Scott, Edward Wilson and Ernest Shackleton reached their farthest south during the Discovery Expedition. Their sledging party travelled to about 82°16′–17′ south on the Antarctic ice shelf, setting a new farthest-south record. They turned back without reaching the South Pole and faced a difficult return journey.
en.n: The party reached its farthest-south point on December 30; it did not reach the South Pole.

zh.t: 斯科特的“发现”号考察队抵达此次远征的最南点
zh.s: 1902年12月30日，罗伯特·斯科特、爱德华·威尔逊和欧内斯特·沙克尔顿在南极雪橇考察中抵达南纬约82度16至17分，刷新了当时人类抵达的最南纪录。他们没有到达南极点，随后踏上艰难的返程。
zh.n: 当天抵达此次考察的最南点，并未到达南极点。

en.s: The Iroquois Theatre fire happened on December 30, 1903, in Chicago, Illinois. It was the deadliest theater fire and the deadliest single-building fire in United States history. At least 602 people died as a result of the fire, but not all the deaths were reported, as some of the bodies were removed from the scene.

zh.s: 1903年12月30日，伊利诺伊州芝加哥易洛魁剧院发生火灾，至少602人死亡，是美国历史上死亡人数最多的剧院火灾，也是单一建筑火灾中死亡人数最多的一次。由于部分遗体被移出现场，实际死亡人数可能更高。

en.s: The Merry Widow (German: Die lustige Witwe [diː ˈlʊstɪɡə ˈvɪtvə]) is an operetta by the Austro-Hungarian composer Franz Lehár. The librettists, Viktor Léon and Leo Stein, based the story – concerning a rich widow, and her countrymen's attempt to keep her money in the principality by finding her the right husband – on an 1861 comedy play, L'attaché d'ambassade (The Embassy Attaché) by Henri Meilhac.

en.t: Treaty on the Creation of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics
en.s: The Declaration and Treaty on the Formation of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (Russian: Декларация и договор об образовании Союза Советских Социалистических Республик) officially created the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR), commonly known as the Soviet Union. It de jure legalised a political union of several Soviet republics that had existed since 1919 and created a new federal government whose key functions were centralised in Moscow. Its legislative branch consisted of the Congress of Soviets and the Central Executive Committee of the Soviet Union, while the Council of People's Commissars composed the executive. The Treaty, along with the Declaration of the Creation of the USSR was approved on 30 December 1922 by a conference of delegations from the Russian SFSR, the Transcaucasian SFSR, the Ukrainian SSR and the Byelorussian SSR.

en.s: The Camp Chapman attack was a suicide attack by Humam Khalil Abu-Mulal al-Balawi against the Central Intelligence Agency facility inside Forward Operating Base Chapman on December 30, 2009. en.s: The 2025 Workday Canberra International was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor hardcourts. It was the seventh edition of the men's tournament, which was part of the 2025 ATP Challenger 125, and the eighth edition of the women's tournament, which was part of the 2025 WTA 125 tournaments. It took place at the Canberra Tennis Centre in Canberra, Australia between 30 December 2024 and 4 January 2025.

zh.s: 2025年Workday堪培拉国际赛是职业网球赛事，包括ATP挑战赛125级别的男子比赛和WTA125级别的女子比赛，分别为第七届和第八届。赛事于2024年12月30日至2025年1月4日在澳大利亚堪培拉网球中心举行。
